name: tabs
behavior: APG tabs pattern (tablist/tab/tabpanel; roving focus — arrow keys move between tabs, Home/End to first/last; activation is automatic on focus by default, manual via Enter/Space when panels are expensive — a declared behavior option, never a theme difference)

parts.note: border-subtle baseline rule under the list in underline-style themes

parts.statesNote: selected trigger switches content-secondary to on-interaction-selected

parts.note: slot for the active-tab bar: bottom edge when horizontal, side edge when vertical; filled-pill themes may express it as interaction-selected fill on the trigger instead — same slot
focusable when it contains no focusable children

anatomyNotes: shadcn's default (pill on muted) vs line (underline) variants are RECIPE differences on list/trigger/selected-indicator, not different anatomy; Salt tabs are the underline recipe.
